name: Commander Elias Varga
want: get every living person off Vesper, and be the last one out
secret: Eight months ago he signed off on putting off the debris-shield refit to keep the probe campaign on schedule; tonight's strike came through the section that refit would have covered.
voice: Low and even, short sentences, calls everyone by surname; the pain shows only in the pauses.
description: Has commanded Vesper for two years. Ex-navy, careful, liked; the crew would follow him into vacuum, and some of them may have to.
appearance: Broad and grey-bearded, a gash over one eye taped shut, his left arm strapped across his chest.
knows: The debris-shield sensors over the observation module flagged faults for weeks before the strike.

steps: takes a head count over the intercom
works out who goes in which pod and who flies with Felix
tries the reactor controls from Ops one more time
